integrity: The exact exponent and W^{1,p} threshold are proved analytically from the published angular equation and domain decomposition. Numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Straight-wedge or locally straight-edged right-angle corner only; coupling normalization 0<|mu|<1 as in arXiv:1902.05010; endpoint values are limits; no exact W^{1,p} transfer to arbitrary curvilinear corners is claimed.
title: Exact right-angle singular exponent and sharp local gradient-integrability threshold for a Lorentz-scalar Dirac shell
